title: A slow or failing doctor probe is named as such, not as an ownership refusal
goal: Update now on a busy machine either proceeds or says NERV did not answer its health check in time, with nothing stopped
acceptance: A committed test fails first across the macOS observation and blockers with a fake slow doctor
The doctor probe waits 5 s and asks twice; an answer within that is owned when it matches
A timeout or non-OK answer names the measured time or status and that nothing was stopped, never OWNERSHIP_UNKNOWN; the runtime stays unknown
Linux and Windows observations use the same probe
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: Never treat an unanswered runtime as owned

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one shared probe, three observations, one blocker message and a join test. Not a measurement.
